examples.aside.title: Page with a side column
examples.aside.text: A page that fills the layout’s aside region
examples.aside.lead: Every dashboard layout has a side region and collapses to one column when nothing fills it. This page fills it — so this is where the region can actually be seen in use.
examples.aside.how_1: Name it in +page.server.ts (or +page.ts) — the shell renders before the page does, so a page cannot hand it a snippet; it names one:
examples.aside.how_2: Register that name in $lib/asides/registry.ts so the component can be code-split:
examples.aside.how_3: The aside component reads the page’s load data through page.data — there is no second load for the side column.
examples.aside.note_ssr: The aside name is resolved on the server, so the side column is in the first HTML and stays there with JavaScript off.
examples.aside.note_theme: The arrangement belongs to the theme, not the page: the active layout decides whether the side column sits right, below, or how wide it is.
examples.aside.note_narrow: On narrow screens layouts stack it under the content — do not put anything that must be read first in there.
examples.aside.count: {n} steps in the side checklist — the data comes from this page’s load.
examples.aside.panel_hint: Its content comes from the page load, not the shell
examples.aside.step_optional: Other pages may have no aside
